full_argv_parser_checks.method: Actual script imports and complete actual argv; argparse.parse_args is intercepted only after successful parsing, before any geometry/body execution. Script sibling import path matches normal Python script invocation.

checks: Input preparation directory is only read/copied by later stages.
Each native source-NNN directory is complete before sealing/generation and later only read/copied.
Region output subdirectories are not changed by collection of sibling regions.json.
The support checkpoint is read/copied during reuse; original supports/support-stage.json is not rewritten.
Process figures add root image/figures files, outside the already hashed layers/ and source/ directories and without rewriting process/report.json.
Guide creates new delivery-assets and guide outputs; workflow.json intermediate snapshot is copied without mutating already declared outputs.

scope: Read-only integration and parser/source review. This does not claim that the 37-stage cold carrier reconstruction has been executed or that numerical assessments have passed.
